component.name: Dynamic Island
component.summary: Live activities in the panel: what's playing, timers and charging
Atividades ao vivo no painel: o que está tocando, timers e carregamento

description.p: Live activities in the COSMIC™ panel, like the iPhone's Dynamic Island and the live activities of macOS: it shows what's going on and opens into it, in the look of COSMIC's own applets.

ul.li: What's playing in any media player, with its cover, and bars dancing in the theme's accent color
Click to open it: the cover, the progress you can drag, and the player's controls
A timer, counting down in the panel, beside the music while it plays
The charger plugged in, shown for a moment
Middle-click the island to play or pause
